pageDescription: Manage AI model providers and model configurations

dashboard.defaultModelInvalid: Default model "{{model}}" is no longer in the available list. Its configuration is preserved; check it or choose another model.
dashboard.defaultModelInvalidMember: Default model "{{model}}" is no longer available. Ask an administrator to choose a new one.
dashboard.toggleCurrency: Click to switch between USD and CNY
dashboard.cacheLegacyHint: These cache reads come from records made before the upgrade, which did not record whether the model service reported cache usage and counted input differently, so the hit rate is unknown; later calls are counted separately
dashboard.cacheUnreportedHint: These calls have no cache usage to go by (the model service did not report it, or they were recorded before the upgrade), so cache hits are unknown, not zero
dashboard.cacheCoverageHint: Hit rate over the {{reported}} / {{total}} calls that reported cache usage; the other calls did not report it or were recorded before the upgrade

fallbacks.title: Auxiliary Models
fallbacks.description: After the primary model fails, Auto tries these models in order. Every new user turn starts with the primary model.
fallbacks.emptyHint: Auto uses its automatic same-provider and cross-provider selection strategy.
fallbacks.removeInvalidHint: Remove disabled, deleted, unconfigured, or primary-model entries before saving.
fallbacks.loadFailed: Failed to load auxiliary model configuration. Nothing can be saved until it is reloaded.

providerList.emptyHintMember: Ask an administrator to add a provider
providerList.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the last successfully loaded providers. {{error}}

detail.configAdminOnly: Only administrators can change model settings
detail.noModelsMember: Ask an administrator to add models

emptyDetail.addFirstHint: Add a provider to manage models and credentials
emptyDetail.selectProviderHint: Select a provider from the left to view details and models

confirmDeleteProvider: Are you sure you want to remove this Provider? This will delete its credential configuration.
confirmDeleteProviderWithDefault: This Provider contains the current default model "{{model}}". Removing it will also clear the default model setting. Continue?
confirmDeleteModel: Are you sure you want to delete model "{{modelId}}"?
confirmDeleteModelWithDefault: Model "{{modelId}}" is the current default model. Deleting it will also clear the default model setting. Continue?

form.apiKeyOptionalHint: If Base URL points to an internal/self-hosted endpoint with no auth, leave this empty and the system will use a placeholder.
form.apiKeyKeepExisting: Leave blank to keep the existing API key
form.credentialNote: Credentials are stored locally with Fernet symmetric encryption. They are never uploaded to any external service.
form.visionPredefinedHint: Vision capability for built-in models is set by the model definition and cannot be changed manually. Add a custom model to override it.
form.fillModelId: Please fill in Model ID and Name
form.azureDeploymentHint: Azure OpenAI requests use the deployment name, not a fixed model name. The preset models are examples; enter your own deployment name here.
form.azureDeploymentRequired: Select at least one preset model or enter an Azure deployment name
form.azureModelIdHint: For Azure OpenAI, Model ID should be the deployment name from Azure Portal.
form.azureNoCustomDeployments: No custom Azure deployment has been added yet.

wizard.providerSavedHint: Successfully added {{name}}. You can add custom models or finish setup.
wizard.noModelsNote: This provider has no predefined models. Please add a custom model to get started.

discovery.title: Fetch models
discovery.stagedHint: Credentials are used only for this request. Selected models are added when you save.
discovery.catalogHint: Built-in recommendations, not a live list for your account. Test imported models to confirm access.
discovery.truncated: Only part of the model list is shown. Other models can be added manually.
discovery.metadataHint: A successful fetch does not confirm access to every model. Capabilities, pricing and context limits omitted by the service remain unconfirmed; edit and test after importing.
discovery.allAdded: All fetched models have already been added.
discovery.empty: The service returned no models. Fetch again or add a model manually.
discovery.failed: Could not fetch models. Review the message above, then retry or add a model manually.
discovery.importPartial: Credentials saved. Some models could not be added; review the results and retry.

unavailable.azure_deployment_required: Enter your actual Azure deployment name; a recommended model name is not a deployment.
unavailable.not_chat_model: This is not a chat model and cannot be imported here.

codes.models_discovered: Select the models you want to add.
codes.catalog_fallback: This service does not expose a model list. Showing built-in recommendations.
codes.discovery_unsupported: Model discovery is not available for this service. Add models manually.
codes.invalid_base_url: Check that the Base URL is a valid, complete URL.
codes.authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Check your API key.
codes.permission_denied: Your credentials do not have permission to list models.
codes.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
codes.upstream_error: The model service returned an error. Check its status and retry.
codes.connection_timeout: Connection timed out. Check the address and network, then retry.
codes.connection_error: Could not connect. Check the service address and network.
codes.invalid_response: The model list response could not be recognized.
codes.response_too_large: The service response is too large. Reduce the returned list or add models manually.
codes.redirect_not_allowed: The service returned a redirect. To protect credentials, it was not followed. Enter the final service URL and retry.

configuration.manageHint: Model edits, deletions and switches apply immediately. Credentials and models to add apply when saved.
configuration.emptyModels: No models added yet. Fetch a model list or add one manually.
configuration.settingsLoadFailed: Model settings could not be loaded. Retry before saving; the existing configuration has been preserved.

connection.title: Check connection
connection.description: Send a model request to check the API key and proxy URL.
connection.saveAndCheckHint: This saves the current credentials and proxy URL before checking. Fetching models does not save credentials.
connection.noModel: Add a model first to check whether requests work.
connection.addBeforeCheck: Fetch and select a model, or enter a deployment name, before saving and checking.
connection.saveAndCheckNewHint: This saves the credentials and selected models before checking. Fetching models does not save credentials.
